rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, I started Halcyon Threshold because superintelligent AI is likely coming within this decade, and most safety-critical decisions about how it happens are being made by a handful of companies. We need independent organizations building knowledge, capabilities, and governance frameworks on the outside—not to oppose labs, but to ensure we're prepared. Labs are getting it right on capabilities but underweighting safety verification: we need independent safety audits, transparent requirements for frontier systems, and diverse voices in decisions about deployment. That's what we're building toward. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Responded to reporter with substantive quote

rows.text: Charged $29.98 to Morgan's card, paid to Nomiq Domains.
rows.quote: Renewed domain halcyonthreshold.org (2 years, through Nov 2028) - $29.98

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, This is incredibly timely. I'm setting up a real roadmap for Halcyon Threshold—moving from concept to concrete work—and I need data-oriented thinking. Right now I'm developing a grant proposal for the Emberfall Fund rapid grants program (due Nov 30). What I need most is help thinking through: 1. What data/analysis would be most valuable for the AI safety + governance community? 2. How could we structure a 3-month project that builds credibility and creates real output? Would you be open to a call this week to discuss? Even 30 minutes would help me sharpen the thinking. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Reached out to Priya with concrete project proposal

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Dear Corvid Institute, Yes, please list Morgan Hale and Halcyon Threshold as signatories to the open letter on frontier training run oversight. This is exactly the kind of governance work that independent organizations need to support. Best, Morgan Hale Halcyon Threshold"
rows.quote: Signed onto Corvid Institute open letter
